attachment_texts.text: Royal Road Minerals Limited made an offer to acquire all outstanding common shares of Caza Gold Corp. Holders will receive 0.16 of a Royal Road ordinary share for each Caza share. The offer is made under cross-border rules and Canadian disclosure documents.
